title: The Best Thread Smart Plugs
subtitle: Matter-over-Thread plugs that strengthen your Thread network, ranked.
intro: Thread plugs are the easiest way to extend a Thread network, because each one routes signal for other devices. We pulled the ones selling on Amazon and scored them on rating, review volume, and features. Every plug here needs a Thread border router.
data_source: Amazon product listings on the data_captured date. Prices, ratings and review counts change daily; check the listing before relying on a number.

buyers_guide.q: What can I plug into a smart plug?
buyers_guide.a: Lamps, fans, coffee makers, holiday lights, and anything else that turns on with a physical switch left in the on position. Check the plug's amp rating (most are 15 A) before plugging in anything that draws a lot of power.

buyers_guide.q: Is energy monitoring worth paying for?
buyers_guide.a: If you want to know what a fridge, dehumidifier, or entertainment center costs to run, yes. Energy-monitoring plugs also let you trigger automations, like an alert when the washer finishes.

buyers_guide.q: Will a smart plug block the second outlet?
buyers_guide.a: Bulky plugs often cover the other socket. Mini designs leave it free, so check the shape before you buy several.

buyers_guide.q: Are smart plugs safe for heaters and air conditioners?
buyers_guide.a: Only if the plug's rating covers the appliance's draw and the maker allows it. Many plugs are rated 15 A, but heaters run near that limit for hours. Check the appliance's manual; some say not to use any timer or smart plug.
